characters.name: Ophilia
characters.title: La flamme dans la neige
characters.scene: Elle protège la flamme sacrée dans le vent, sur le chemin enneigé d’une chapelle.
characters.detail: OPHILIA CLEMENT, the gentle young adult cleric from Octopath Traveler I. Recognizable pale blonde hair and modest flowing white-and-blue ecclesiastical robes with restrained gold edging and her original headdress. Quiet courage in her face, not blank serenity. Walks diagonally toward us through shallow snow, head slightly turned to watch a small steady blue sacred flame cupped in a ceremonial metal lantern bowl near her chest with one hand; other hand holds her long ornate staff upright with a clear natural grip, shaft can leave lower frame. Wind catches robe hem, shoulders protect the flame. Wide snowy path, one softly suggested chapel doorway behind, blue winter morning and gentle amber window bounce. Knee-to-head or near full-body, camera slightly above hand level, face clear. No giant church facade, halo or wings.

characters.name: Cyrus
characters.title: La page manquante
characters.scene: Une découverte l’interrompt au milieu d’une lecture dans les archives.
characters.detail: CYRUS ALBRIGHT, adult elegant scholarly man from Octopath Traveler I, recognizable long dark hair tied back with loose face strands, handsome thoughtful face, burgundy/red scholar's coat, white shirt, dark tailored layers. Seated sideways at a library reading desk, one leg naturally forward, an open heavy book supported by his left hand at the desk edge. His right index finger has stopped on one line as he turns his head toward a shaft of light, eyebrows lifted by a brilliant realization, small knowing smile. A few tiny controlled pale-blue magical signs near the page with NO readable writing. Composition waist/thigh-to-head, asymmetrical desk edge low. Behind him only one deep shadowed shelf and a tall frosted window, no hundreds of sharp books. Dusty cool daylight warms face against wine red cloth, rich brushstrokes.

characters.name: Tressa
characters.title: L’horizon vaut le détour
characters.scene: Sur le quai, elle vérifie son carnet de voyage avant d’embarquer.
characters.detail: TRESSA COLZIONE, the young merchant from Octopath Traveler I, faithful youthful NON-sexualized appearance, short brown hair and distinctive wide-brimmed merchant hat with feather, original layered green/cream travel outfit, sturdy boots, travel pack with coherent straps. Cheerful determined curiosity. Standing on a quiet harbor jetty with one foot on a small secure mooring block; she holds her travel journal open in one hand and steadies the brim of her hat with the other against the sea breeze, looking toward a departing vessel outside frame, excited slightly mischievous smile. A simple straight merchant spear securely strapped along the pack, not floating. Generous full figure with natural proportions. Broad turquoise sea, a single soft ochre sail and white sky; no cluttered port, crates everywhere or crowd. Bright morning with tactile worn cloth, not cartoon.

characters.name: Olberic
characters.title: Tenir le passage
characters.scene: Il se place en garde sur un pont de campagne pour protéger le passage.
characters.detail: OLBERIC EISENBERG from Octopath Traveler I, powerful mature veteran male warrior, swept-back short dark hair, rugged square face with stubble, faithful heavy dark-and-steel armor with his blue cloth and weathered leather. Planting himself side-on in a broad grounded defensive stance on a simple stone country bridge, stern protective resolve, looking toward unseen threat beyond left edge. Both hands grip the SAME straight long sword at its clearly continuous hilt, held diagonally forward and down in a plausible low guard; blade length remains natural and may leave frame. No shield or second weapon in those hands. Powerful but human proportions, broad mid-full framing, boots grounded. Quiet river valley, one parapet and soft pale green hillside, storm light breaking onto battered steel. No wreckage, army, exaggerated giant shoulders or angry shouting.

characters.name: Primrose
characters.title: Derrière le sourire
characters.scene: À la fin d’un pas de danse, son regard demeure froid et résolu.
characters.detail: PRIMROSE AZELHART, adult dancer from Octopath Traveler I. Recognizable dark brown long hair swept up with ornate gold headpiece, deep crimson and burgundy flowing dancer costume with gold jewelry, faithful to her base design, elegant not erotic. Caught in a deliberate graceful half-turn on a wooden stage: weight over one stable leg, other foot following a real dance step, right arm softly arced at shoulder height, left hand gathers a small fold of fabric at hip with natural fingers. Her face is turned toward viewer's left, poised stage smile barely hiding sadness and fierce purpose. A small sheathed dagger subtly secured at waist, not drawn. Entire head and both hands clearly visible, hem can flow out at lower edge. Background a single ochre curtain, broad dim auditorium shadow and one low warm stage lantern; no audience faces or ornate busy set. Bronze warm rim and quiet wine red, painterly narrative gravity.

characters.name: Alfyn
characters.title: Le remède avant la route
characters.scene: Accroupi près d’un banc, il prépare une dose de remède avec un sourire rassurant.
characters.detail: ALFYN GREENGRASS, warm adult male apothecary from Octopath Traveler I, tousled brown hair, familiar green coat, off-white shirt, leather satchel with a few practical bottles, sturdy boots. Genuinely friendly and competent, subtle freckles or weathered cheeks, no silly caricature. Crouching naturally beside a low wooden bench outside a village cottage, both forearms supported near knees; one hand holds a small mortar securely on the bench, other crushes herbs with a pestle, while he looks up at an unseen patient with a reassuring open smile. Only two hands, clear elbow paths. His compact axe is safely sheathed at belt behind hip. Mid-full framing including crouched legs, not crammed. Quiet pale plaster wall, open green door and one low herb bed in soft focus, gentle leaf-filtered daylight. Rich worn cloth and wood, simple scene, no crowded potion shop.

characters.name: Therion
characters.title: Une dette au poignet
characters.scene: Il s’arrête sous une arcade, une pierre dérobée cachée dans sa main.
characters.detail: THERION, the adult thief from Octopath Traveler I, recognizable short messy silver-gray hair, narrow watchful eyes, burgundy scarf partly covering neck, dark practical leather travel clothing and his restrictive metal wrist bangle visible. Standing against the inner side of a quiet stone arch after a heist, body angled away but head turns back sharply over shoulder, guarded distrust. Left hand near chest hides one small luminous green Dragonstone under curled fingers, right hand holds one slender straight dagger low beside thigh, coherent blade and grip. Do not hide arms behind the torso ambiguously; both arm paths readable. Cropped below knees, silhouette long and lean, scarf trails naturally. Broad midnight blue wall, single warm distant window reflected on rain-dark pavement, no city vista, guards or debris. Restrained green reflection on palm, no VFX storm.

characters.name: H’aanit
characters.title: À l’écoute des bois
characters.scene: Elle écoute la forêt, son arc abaissé, tandis que Linde veille à ses côtés.
characters.detail: H'AANIT, the adult huntress from Octopath Traveler I, recognizable long ash-brown/silver-brown hair in high ponytail, confident angular face, faithful earth-toned hunter leathers and soft fur trim, practical boots and leg wraps. She stands in a slight forward lean on a forest path with one knee bent over a low log, calm focused eyes scanning to the right. Left hand holds an undrawn wooden hunting bow down alongside her body with one continuous taut bowstring attached at both tips; right hand raised near shoulder in a small quiet halt gesture, not pulling the string. Coherent limbs and straight arrows in a securely strapped quiver. Her familiar Linde, a large spotted snow-leopard-like feline, is partly visible beside her lower leg looking in the same direction, not fused into character. Wide medium-full framing. Only two great tree trunks and soft mossy clearing, no dense leaf detail. Cool green filtered dawn with warm skin, poised alert companionship.

characters.name: Hikari
characters.title: Le sabre retenu
characters.scene: Dans une cour balayée par le sable, il retient son coup et reprend sa garde.
characters.detail: HIKARI KU from Octopath Traveler II, young adult East Asian prince-warrior, recognizable dark tied hair, crimson layered samurai-inspired robe and dark lamellar pieces, deep red sash, faithful original design. Caught at the end of a controlled sword step, three-quarter profile facing left, shoulders angled, front knee flexed and rear heel slightly lifted, natural balanced footwork. Both hands hold ONE katana on same continuous hilt at mid-torso, blade extends clearly toward upper left, normal subtle katana curve only, never bent or foreshortened into a stub. His expression mixes restraint, sorrow and unshakeable resolve, not a scream. Generous framing down to shins, leave room above blade. Quiet pale sand courtyard with ONE red wooden gateway softened behind, desert daylight and long cool shadow. No battle crowd or decorative particles.
